chapters.title: Automatic email processing and shipping addresses
Alternative dates and natural language guidance

features.name: Sales order agent automatic email processing
features.description: The sales order agent can now automatically process incoming emails from registered customers without manual approval, extracting details and creating quotes or orders instantly with user review and approval before sending.

features.name: Sales order agent multiple shipping addresses
features.description: The sales order agent recognizes requests for specific shipping addresses and searches for them among addresses registered for the customer, then records the address on the generated quote.
features.status_evidence_quote: The agent now recognizes requests for a specific shipping address, searching for it among the addresses registered for that customer
caveats: requires addresses to be pre-registered in Business Central

features.name: Sales order agent alternative delivery dates
features.description: When a customer requests a shipping date that cannot be met, the sales order agent suggests alternative dates the company can promise based on delivery capability.

features.name: Sales order agent natural language guidance
features.description: If the sales order agent encounters a scenario it cannot resolve independently, users can provide natural language instructions to guide it forward without restarting the entire process.

features.name: Sales order agent European availability
features.description: The sales order agent and its latest capabilities are now available in Denmark, Spain, Germany, France, and Italy for European customers.
features.status_evidence_quote: the sales order agent and its latest capabilities are now available in Denmark, Spain, Germany, France, and Italy

features.name: Payables agent
features.description: The Payables Agent automates vendor invoice processing by consuming invoice attachments from emails, classifying expenses using AI and accounting knowledge, creating purchase invoice documents, and leveraging purchase history for accurate registration.
features.status_evidence_quote: It's currently in public preview across four English-speaking countries with general availability coming soon.
caveats: requires finance team review before posting

features.name: MCP server for Business Central
features.description: MCP server for Business Central enables external agent builders like Microsoft Copilot Studio or third-party platforms to securely access Business Central data using the MCP protocol, allowing custom agents to interact with Business Central from Microsoft 365, Teams, Outlook, or other systems.
features.status_evidence_quote: we're introducing the public preview of MCP server for Business Central

quotes.text: you can now configure the agent to automatically process incoming emails from your registered customers

quotes.text: No manual approval required. The agent reads the request, extracts the details, and gets to work instantly.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the automation level - the agent operates independently until sending a response to the customer

quotes.text: It's currently in public preview across four English-speaking countries with general availability coming soon.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the Payables Agent status as preview with limited geographic availability and future GA planned

quotes.why_it_matters: Announces the MCP server public preview, enabling external platforms to access Business Central securely
